title: A voice journal with text
description: An entry can be reread and found by search, while it can still be heard.

blocks.text: Speech sometimes helps express what is hard to type quickly.

quote.text: They told me that journaling would help, but I hate journaling because my brain goes faster than the pen. When I do my journaling using this app, I use the microphone feature and I just talk out loud and let it all type out.

blocks.text: Keep the audio and the transcription together, tie a line to the moment it was recorded, and allow the text to be corrected. Move both to a new device.
Deleting the original audio should be a separate choice, not a hidden step in processing.
